required_cases: replace the retired response/progress authorization projection with native claim, explicit-renewal CAS, producer-decision, recovery and atomic terminal-effect adapters

IMPLEMENTATION-LAYER EXPERIMENT: reconstruct authorized canonical messages, build the real CompletionRequest through its existing owner, and project/serialize it through the configured ProviderInputCounter. Do not recreate provider serialization in a fixture or substitute payload-length sums.

Observe the real projected body and the estimate passed to ReductionAdmission::for_input. Include metadata, escaping, tool schemas and framing; respect the existing exclusion of output-limit fields and the configured effective-budget calculation.

Construct and measure complete requests at effective budget and one estimated token above it. Assert equality is NotNeeded and only a strictly greater estimate is reduction-eligible. Raw payload byte counts cannot stand in for these measured boundaries.
Exercise literal-expanded and head/tail presentations and missing dependencies; incomplete reconstruction must not become a smaller dispatchable request.
After reduction, rebuild and reproject the complete request and reject dispatch if its new estimate still exceeds the effective budget.

The formal join now binds canonical reconstruction, fallible projection/estimation, reduction and rebuilt admission. Its callbacks remain native premises: controlled conformance observations and payload fixtures do not establish that real provider serialization produced the estimate.

Native HTTP capture tests compare persisted input accounting with the production estimator applied to the actual received request body, including every dispatched turn of a three-turn compaction scenario. All dispatched estimates fit the effective budget. Exact equality/one-over boundary construction, literal/window coverage, and incomplete-dependency rejection remain required experiments.

Native publication and partial-text recovery tests inject a task-local failure after every successful ConfigApplyTxn mutation and compare persisted facts; successful second-fixture mutation counts pin complete fault coverage. Recovery exact-identity replay performs zero writes. Running-tool recovery accounting and downstream dispatch/continuation/token-charge replay effects remain separate obligations.

Native renewal tests run the actual renewal task while two read stand-ins block, and stop polling past the stored deadline before rejecting renewal and recovering the request. These establish independent timer operation and expired-owner fencing, not actual provider/tool integration, OS suspend, or system-clock discontinuity.
concurrent identical creates resolve to one immutable identity

The native genesis test races identical creates, verifies duplicate-create and changed-content identity behavior, then feeds both persisted closing records to canonical reconstruction in both arrival orders and under either closure reference: each reports ConflictingClosures, never a selected winner. Open-flush ordinal twins and cross-process replication remain separate coverage.
